purpose: Three standalone Meshy character reference sheets; working concepts, not imported or rigged models.

characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one standalone character turnaround sheet for the original Pockle collectible toy game, intended as a reference for Meshy image-to-3D. Create a square high-resolution sheet with EXACTLY FOUR separated views of ONE identical toy, equal scale in a 2 by 2 grid: front upper left, strict left profile upper right, rear lower left, front three-quarter lower right. Neutral upright standing pose identical in every view. Entire toy visible in every quadrant with generous margins. Plain white studio background, very soft contact shadows, no floor line, no platform or scenery. Original premium cute soft vinyl collectible style, rounded tactile forms, bottom-heavy proportions, small broad feet, smooth satin finish, restrained highlights, flat painted dark-plum oval eyes with tiny glints and simple painted curved smile on a clean smooth face surface suitable for later eye/mouth animation. Not sculpted eye sockets or deeply carved mouths. Consistent anatomy, palette and accessory placement across all four views; no face on the back. No text, names, labels, logos, watermark, arrows, borders, extra pose insets, extra characters, material variants, transparent jelly, glitter or glow. Thick integrated accessories, no loose props, no thin fragile features, no realistic fur or fabric fibers.
Subject: a new baby reindeer creature. A very large softly rounded caramel-brown head flowing into a small plump pear-shaped body, cream oval muzzle and belly patch, little dark cocoa bean-shaped nose (not red), two broad rounded leaf-shaped ears, two SHORT thick biscuit-colored antlers with just TWO blunt rounded tips each, chunky short arms resting at the sides, two broad dark-cocoa hoof feet, tiny rounded cream tail. A simple cranberry-red molded neck collar with a single thick mint-green oval clasp centered on the chest, no dangling scarf. Friendly neutral expression, soft apricot cheek dots. Antlers visibly substantial and fully visible in all views. No hat, no sleigh, no realistic deer anatomy. Character-specific motion possibilities implied by separate readable ears, arms and tail; no motion drawings.

Subject: a new baby penguin creature, distinct from a snowman. One squat egg-shaped blue-slate body, a large clean warm-ivory continuous face-and-belly patch, tiny rounded apricot-orange beak below expressive dark eyes and above a small dark-plum smile, two short thick rounded flippers extending slightly from the sides, two wide apricot oval feet and one short thick upward-pointing blue tail at the rear. Oversized soft mint-green earmuff pads sit at the SIDES of its head connected by one broad smooth mint headband closely hugging the crown, chunky and fully integrated, no fur. No hat, no scarf, no clothing, no loose elements. Subtle peach cheek blush. Same headphone-style earmuff anatomy in all views. Soft vinyl rather than real feathers, visible flippers suitable for future wave/wiggle animations.

Subject: an original sentient wrapped-present creature. A squat cushion-shaped rounded cube, very soft peach-coral box body with exaggerated rounded corners, two tiny rounded coral arms and two broad cream stub feet; tiny rounded flat coral tail-free back. A broad molded mint-green ribbon runs vertically down the center of front and back and across the lid, plus a horizontal mint ribbon around the sides LOWER on the body. The FRONT face is positioned on the upper coral area ABOVE the horizontal ribbon, with two large dark-plum oval eyes on either side of the narrow vertical mint stripe and a tiny simple painted smile slightly below the eyes. On top a single oversized mint bow: TWO thick plump solid teardrop lobes and ONE rounded central knot, no open loops or ribbon holes, no thin trailing ends. A playful simple gift-box identity with clean body faces; no lid seam across the face, no removable lid, no feet-like ribbons, no Christmas printed patterns, no question marks. Broad bow lobes provide readable future wiggle/bob articulation. Same bow, ribbon routes and cubical volume in all four views.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone four-view character turnaround sheet for Meshy image-to-3D, matching the original Pockle soft collectible toy family. Replace the proposed gift-box character with a NEW food character: a baby Christmas plum pudding, working name Pud. One very squat, plump, rounded dome of warm cocoa-brown pudding, flat soft base, broad little cinnamon-brown oval feet and two small attached rounded cocoa arms. A thick warm-vanilla icing cap covers the top third with exactly three broad rounded drips on the front and a few broad drips continuing around the back. The icing MUST leave a broad unobstructed cocoa-brown face area below: two simple dark-plum glossy oval eyes with tiny glints, tiny curved painted smile, subtle peach blush. Clean smooth surface for future animated eyes/mouth, no deep sockets or sculpted mouth. One chunky holly garnish molded into the crown: two thick soft sage-green leaf forms, rounded lobes instead of sharp points, and three attached cranberry-red berry spheres clustered at the centre. All garnish rests on the icing, firmly attached, no floating elements. Body smooth satin squishy vinyl/foam, very subtle fine pudding texture only, no protruding fruit chunks, no sauce puddle, no plate, no spoon, no wrapper, no hat, no scarf, no gift-box elements. Original adorable toy proportions, simple iconic silhouette and readable arms/topping for later hop, sway, wave and topping wobble. Food reads clearly as a round Christmas pudding, NOT a cup, cupcake, gingerbread bear, mushroom or snowman.
Composition: square high-resolution image, EXACTLY FOUR clean separated views of the SAME IDENTICAL character, equal scale, 2 by 2 layout. FRONT upper left, STRICT LEFT SIDE upper right, BACK lower left, FRONT THREE-QUARTER lower right. Identical neutral standing pose and consistent anatomy, icing coverage/drip placement, holly orientation and colors across views. Full toy including leaves and feet visible in each quadrant, generous white margins and separation. Plain white studio background, soft diffuse studio lighting, very subtle contact shadows, no floor line, platforms or scenery. No face on the rear.
